mapper.select: SELECT CODE_GRP, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT, UPPER_CODE FROM OPS_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDR

SELECT C.CODE_GRP AS CODE_GRP, G.GRP_NM AS GRP_NM, C.CODE_ID AS CODE_ID, C.CODE_NM AS CODE_NM, C.SORT_ORDR AS SORT_ORDR, C.USE_AT AS USE_AT, C.UPPER_CODE AS UPPER_CODE FROM OPS_CODE C LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE_GRP G ON G.GRP_CD = C.CODE_GRP WHERE 1 = 1
AND CODE_GRP = #{searchCondition}
AND (CODE_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR CODE_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY CODE_GRP, SORT_ORDR OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CODE (CODE_GRP, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT, UPPER_CODE) VALUES (#{codeGrp}, #{codeId}, #{codeNm}, #{sortOrdr}, #{useAt}, #{upperCode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OPS_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} AND CODE_ID = #{codeId}
mapper.select: SELECT GRP_NM FROM OPS_CODE_GRP WHERE GRP_CD = #{codeGrp}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OPS_CODE_GRP WHERE GRP_CD = #{codeGrp}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CODE_GRP (GRP_CD, GRP_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT) VALUES (#{codeGrp}, #{grpNm}, 99, 'Y')
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_CODE_GRP SET GRP_NM = #{grpNm} WHERE GRP_CD = #{codeGrp}
